topics.title: Introduction to Python
topics.description: Python is a high-level, interpreted programming language known for its readability and versatility. It is widely used in web development, data science, AI, and automation scripts.

topics.title: Environment Setup
topics.description: Learn how to install Python, set up virtual environments using venv, and configure your code editor for optimal Python development.

topics.title: Variables & Data Types
topics.description: In Python, you don't need to declare variable types explicitly. Core data types include Integers, Floats, Strings, Booleans, Lists, Tuples, and Dictionaries.

topics.title: Control Flow
topics.description: Control flow structures dictate the execution path of your program. They include if-elif-else statements for conditional logic, and for/while loops for iterating over sequences.

topics.title: Functions & Scope
topics.description: Functions are reusable blocks of code defined using the 'def' keyword. They help modularize your code, keep it DRY, and establish local vs global variable scopes.

topics.title: Object-Oriented Programming
topics.description: Python fully supports OOP concepts. You can define classes, create objects, and utilize inheritance, polymorphism, and encapsulation to structure complex applications.
